\chapter{ECSA Exit Level Outcomes}

This section addresses the following Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) exit level outcomes and indicates how each outcome was demonstrated in the project.

\section*{GA 1 - Problem-Solving}

The project addresses an engineering problem, which is the lack of a joint design for PCMAs that provides a reliable, constant holding torque to ensure the PCMA's stability. 

\section*{GA 2 - Application Scientific and Engineering Knowledge}

This outcome was demonstrated by using mathematical formulae and computational methods to evaluate the holding torque and structural inetgrity of the engineering components within the PCMA joint. Principles of mechanics and physical science were used to reason and conceptualise the friction produced, the load-bearing capabilities, and the locking mechanics necessary to achieve reliable position-holding.
